There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. On Sunday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Also, heavy rain caused flooding, and the resulting damage was serious.

Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. For example, the monopoly kept a stranglehold on local phone services.
Lily's dream job is to be a nurse. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
